avis.texte: This seems to work well to refine pores but not helping the acne.
Take care of the only skin you got. And this is a product that actually really helps defend that skin against dryness,wrinkles and enhances the look and texture of the surface.

I love this product!! I've only been using it about a week now and can already see improvement in my skin's texture/tone!! I have mild rosacea and this seems to be helping with the redness. I will note that using it twice a day was too much at first for my skin. I recommend using once a day for the first week or so and then gradually increasing to twice a day.

It took some getting used to with my skin but WOW does it make a difference. Im sensitive so cant use vitamin c serum with tretinon but this pairs BEAUTIFULLY for me with tretinon treatment. Love that I can also use this twice a day!

Please don't ever stop making this! I was recommended azaleic acid to help with my acne, and this specific one is the only one I found that does not contain pore clogging ingredients. My acne has made a significant improvement after one time. I can't wait to see how it continues to work. This is an amazing product!!! I do let it dry completely for one minute and put a moisturizer over top of it, especially since I can't put this around my eyes. But it works great as a serum.

Cant believe how well this works.. most azelaic acid serums have ingredients i cant use.. this one doesn't. Ive been using it for a gew months now, along with the sulur cleanser, and im in disbelief at how much better my skin looks.. i breakout much less now, and when i do break out, its not as bad and goes away faster!! Ive also noticed that as long as i use this most nights, ive had a few nights where i slept in makeup and did no skin care routine, and STILL didnt break out?! Incredible. Ive had bad skin for 15 years and nothinf works like this does…

I have very distinct combination skin (my forehead and nose are oily and very acne prone, but the rest of my face is very dry, sensitive, and allergy prone). I got this product and only applied it to my forehead and nose, and within a day or two my ENTIRE BODY was dry and itchy with small bumps, especially my face, but not where I applied it. I looked it up and according to the Mayo Clinic, this is a reaction that some people experience to azelaic acid. If you have not dealt with skin sensitivity or allergies in the past, I'm sure this product works great, but just a warning.
I got this bc i just experienced my first rosacea flare up although i had to use a whole regimen this is one of the main products (Azelic acid) it works well. Helped minimize the redness
I love using proactive but the acne on my jaw lines are very stubborn

Thank you for creating this product. I've tried so many different products for the rosacea around my nose & face area. Please do not change the formula. This really works and controlled it where I don't even have breakouts. And it also helps with dark spots. Doesn't clear them up right away but I can see my face getting lighter.

My daughter and I absolutely love the Azelaic Pore Perfector. We have very sensitive skin and have moderate acne. The sensitive skin system has been amazing especially the #2 pore perfector. This has been the only system we have found to REALLY work for our skin. Please don't ever get rid of this system we love it! The other systems didn't work they were too harsh and caused more breakouts. Thank you proactiv

Using each night to keep acne at bay and even my skintone.

I love to use this before makeup. I feel like i look smoother, less red and it defintely helped my dry texture.

I bought this despite there being one mediocre review, but I needed something to help clear my skin since it hates salicylic acid. I knew my skin liked azelaic acid so I tried this-it's definitely clearer and brighter in no time! & 3oz is a lot.

I tried this product on face and then chest/back for mild/mod acne. I use salicylic acid and a retinoid in my routine as well. I noticed no difference in acne during my time using this product (2-3 weeks). Too mild for my face, unknown concentration.
